cases.name: test_temporal_persistent_history_restart_and_duplicate_policy
cases.failure_message: TypeError: _fixture_argv() got multiple values for argument 'action'

cause: The TC argv builder named its positional subcommand argument action, colliding with the forwarded probe option action=phase1 before the client process was spawned. This is a test-harness call construction defect, not a passed restart/history check or evidence of a Temporal server defect.
correction: Rename only the helper positional parameter to subcommand; keep the five-case inventory, versions, timeouts and all history/retention/duplicate-start oracles.

owned_cleanup.note: Server exited0; worker received TERM before the probe/worker readiness sequence. No clean-positive-lifecycle acceptance is claimed for this failed attempt.

raw_evidence.publication: Hashes and synthetic case/failure summary only. Raw service/worker logs, database, source ZIP and process identities remain private.
